changes.name: Damp paper handling
changes.authorQuote: For future scenes, a damp paper copy must dry flat before anyone turns its pages.

value.description: A damp paper copy must be laid out and dried flat before anyone turns its pages; no one may turn the pages while the sheet is still damp.
invariants: Damp paper dries flat before anyone turns its pages.
